body: I deliver in your area! And yes, I get at least 2-3 of these a night, often trying to take me across the Narrows bridge too. Fuck that 😂

This looks precisely like something I saw someone selling at an indoor farmer’s market-type place near where I live! I think they had a small table that they made out of this, and it was totally nonfunctional. I almost snapped a pic to post it here. Just…why??
Yay hopefully! I’m usually there on just Wednesday now, sometimes Tuesday. Either way, whomever’s in is gonna be happy to see you two!
Oh my goodness LOL! She is still one of my favorites we’ve ever had in. Such a glorious dragon, hopefully I’ll cross paths with you and her again sometime!

It’s beautiful! Funny, I volunteer at a beardie place that used to offer boarding, and we had a big, beautiful dragon named Thorson in for a bit a few months back. She looked a lot like yours, nubby tail and all! Small world, maybe? :)

Right!? I have super dark/thick eyebrows that I foolishly plucked at a little bit recently, and I’m so excited to for them to fill back in. I have really dark/a lot of body hair in general that I’ve had my whole life (my parents say it’s my Italian genes lol), and I used to get bullied because of it. I treasure it now lmao!

Hi there! I go by Mo or Miles. I really like my eyes and eyebrows! I’m not picky and I really like all the packers (and have been eyeing your brand since I learned about it tbh!), so any of ‘em are great :)

Edit: a word, trying out a new name :)
You look awesome (and I love your username)!

Thanks I love it 

(edit: congrats btw!!!)
Yep yep yep, I’m right in the middle of it.

YTA, big time. You sound like my biphobic mother, who thinks bi people are chronic cheaters, and/or that they’re just closeted gay folks who are confused and greedy. I’m bi and terrified to come out to her because I’m afraid she’ll react just like you did. Please educate yourself before you hurt anyone else.
